description: Splits a merged Cognigy.AI contact profile back into separate profiles. Use when profiles were incorrectly merged. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to unmerge.

contactId.description: The contact ID to extract into a separate profile

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without unmerging. Set to false to actually unmerge.

profileId.description: The merged profile ID to split

name: unmerge_contact_profiles
